Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with severe abdominal pain and vomiting

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a clinical care coordinator at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 55-year-old female patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their first dose of DemoZanix (dose: 1 tablet twice daily) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-06-05.
Approximately 9 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed severe abdominal pain and vomiting.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
T. Larsen (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter775@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
